headline: India Homes Limited reports ₹4.27 crore profit for Q2
hook: Settlements drive India Homes quarterly profit
summary: India Homes Limited recorded a net profit of ₹4.27 crore for the second quarter. The earnings were primarily supported by income from settlements. This result reflects the company's current operational performance for the period ending September.
why_it_matters: Profitability driven by one-time settlements may not indicate recurring operational growth.
